summary:
Implemented two visible iPhone slices:

1. Garage Recent Handoffs now has a latest-handoff review card, `Share Latest`, `Open Latest`, per-item share actions, and an in-panel manual copy fallback when iOS clipboard/share fails.
2. Anton status now detects stale `running` states after 20 minutes without heartbeat on both Home and `anton.html`, showing inspect-controls guidance instead of â€œAnton is workingâ€ indefinitely.

Also fixed a Garage reliability bug where saving a maintenance staging run note was registering `onOwnerAuthChange` repeatedly. Bumped PWA cache to `ridgeline-console-v424` and updated `AGENT_STATE.md`.
